about.description:
Local PDF optimization for macOS.

Data and vector compression, conservative mask repair, page comparison and macOS rendering checks.

Results depend on the document. Your original stays unchanged.

Open source under the MIT license. Uses Python, pypdf, Pillow and PDFium; third-party licenses are included.
